items.title: 15.3.4 Applications of paper chromatography (paper chromatography ke istemal) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.3.4 with Quick Check 15.4, printed pages 331-332.

items: Chromatography ki techniques organic synthesis (organic compounds banane) mein products ko alag karne, isolation (nikalne) aur purify (saaf) karne ke liye bohat useful (faidemand) hain. Yeh qualitative aur quantitative analysis mein aur kisi substance ki purity (kitna pure hai) maloom karne mein bhi utni hi important hain.
Chromatography dyes (rang), drugs (dawaiyan) aur pesticides (keeray maar dawaiyan) jaise complicated (uljhe hue) chemicals pehchanne ke liye bohat useful hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Paper chromatography mein mixture ke components kis basis (bunyad) par ek doosre se alag hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Har component stationary phase (kaghaz ke cellulose mein phansa pani) aur mobile phase (oopar chadhta organic solvent) ke darmiyan different (alag alag) tarah bant-ta hai. Jo mobile phase mein zyada hal hota hai woh tez aur door jata hai; jo stationary phase se zyada chipakta hai woh peeche rehta hai. Is liye har component ki apni Rf value hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Paper chromatography mein stationary aur mobile phases kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Stationary phase: kaghaz ke cellulose fibers mein phansa hua pani. Mobile phase: kaghaz par oopar chadhne wala solvent, aam taur par organic liquid, jo is pani se nahi milta.

blocks.prompt: c) Paper chromatography se kisi substance ki purity kaise maloom ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Substance ka spot (saath pure known samples ke spots) laga kar chromatogram chalate hain. Pure substance sirf ek spot deta hai jis ki Rf pure sample jaisi ho; ek se zyada spots ka matlab hai substance impure hai.

blocks.prompt: Paper chromatography ke teen practical uses batayein.
blocks.explanation: Organic synthesis ke product ki purity jaanchna (ek spot ya kai); ink ya khane ke rang mein dyes ko known dyes se Rf mila kar pehchanna; sample mein drugs ya pesticides ka pata lagana.

items: Istemal: organic synthesis mein products alag karna, nikalna aur saaf karna; qualitative aur quantitative analysis; purity ki jaanch; dyes, drugs aur pesticides ki pehchan.
